title: Vocabulary aligned with Ableton Live
description:
Decided by the user 2026-09-24. Spec: design/vocabulary.md.

- Sample (file) · Clip (a named region, saved with the sample or defined in a score) · Transient · Kit · Slice (was chop) · Pad · Track · Note (was trigger) · Return/Group track (was bus) · Volume (was gain) · time 4/4 (was meter) · warp repitch (was off) · Collection (was crate).
- Old words become errors that name the new ones.
- Tasks 1+2 land together with task 4 so master never speaks two vocabularies.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Tasks 1, 2, 4 and 5 were done by the web/docs session (the user asked us to do the renames ourselves) and committed. Task 3 (storage contract: Clip→Sample, Slice→Clip, Crate→Collection, ScoreRef.sliceId, the @clp_/@slc_ ids, curation's 'crate' and 'hit' kinds, apricity-data's manifest reader) is still open for the storage session. Note: the manifests are now v2 (annotations.clips); apricity-data's uncommitted loader reads 'slices' and will need the new key.
